paper.title: Improved Variance-Aware Confidence Sets for Linear Bandits and Linear Mixture MDP

settings.name_in_paper: Linear Bandits (with context sets A_k, unknown per-round variance)
unmapped: Rewards bounded |r_k| <= 1; noise is a martingale difference with unknown, round-varying conditional variance sigma_k^2
Action set A_k subset of the unit ball given each round (arbitrary, possibly changing)
settings.definition_quote: At each round $k = 1, \ldots, K,$ the algorithm is first given the context set $\gA_k \subseteq \sB_2^d(1),$ then the algorithm chooses an action $\vx_k \in \gA_k$ and receives the noisy reward $r_k = \vx_k \vtheta^* + \varepsilon_k,$ where $\vtheta^* \in \sB^d_2(1)$ ... We assume that $\abs{r_k} \le 1$ and that the noise $\varepsilon_k$ satisfies $\E[\varepsilon_k \mid \gF_k] = 0$ and $\E[\varepsilon_k^2 \mid \gF_k] = \sigma_k^2.$

unmapped: Episodic reinforcement learning (MDP with states, horizon H), not a bandit
Transition P = sum_i theta_i^* P_i with known base models P_i, theta^* in l1 unit ball
Time-homogeneous transitions; known reward function; total reward per episode bounded by 1 (Assumption 1)
K episodes; regret measured in episodes
settings.definition_quote: A linear mixture MDP is an episodic MDP with the extra assumption that its transition model is an unknown linear combination of a known set of models. Specifically, there is an unknown parameter $\vtheta^* \in \sB^d_1(1)$, such that $P = \sum_{i = 1}^d \theta_i^* P_i$ where based models $P_1,\ldots,P_d$ are given.

symbols.sum_var: sum over rounds k=1..T of the unknown conditional noise variance sigma_k^2

source.label: thm:oful
source.quote: The expected regret of Algorithm~\ref{algo:bandit} is bounded by $\E[\Reg^K] \le \widetilde{O}( d^{4.5} \sqrt{\sum_{k=1}^K \sigma_k^2} + d^5)$.

results.notes: Paper's K (rounds) is T. Variances unknown to learner. Algorithm uses K in iota and the net, so horizon known. Elimination over a net of size exponential in d; paper states it is not computationally efficient.

symbols.sum_var: sum over rounds of the unknown conditional noise variance sigma_k^2

source.label: lem:bandit-conf-sum
source.quote: With probability $1 - O(\delta \log K),$ we have \sum_{k} \vx_k \vmu_k \le O\Bigg( d^{4.5} \big(\log^4 dK\big) \big(\log \frac{dK}{\delta}\big) \bigg( \sqrt d + \sqrt{\sum_{k=1}^K \sigma_k^2}\bigg)\Bigg).

results.notes: Lemma bounds sum_k x_k mu_k, which upper-bounds the regret on the event theta* in all confidence sets (shown in text). Failure probability O(delta log K). Lemma number estimated from shared theorem counter.

source.label: thm:main_rl
source.quote: The expected regret of Algorithm~\ref{alg:main} is bounded by $\E[\Reg^K ] \leq  \widetilde{O}\left(d^{4.5}\sqrt{ K }+d^9\right)$.

results.notes: Õ hides polylog(H, K, d) factors; dependence on H is only logarithmic. Not computationally efficient (elimination-based).
